 The Hon'Ble Sri Justice K.Sarath

sentences.text:
Heard learned counsel appearing for the petitioner and learned Assistant Government Pleader for Panchayat Raj and Rural Development and learned Standing Counsel for Gram Panchayat appearing for the respondents and perused the entire material on record.
2.

This petition is filed questioning the action of the respondents in trying to dispossess the petitioner by way of demolishing and interfering with his possession over the house bearing No.3-35/3, admeasuring 30'x30' feet situated at Jalalpur Village, Varni Mandal, Nizamabad District without following due procedure contemplated under law.

3. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that at the stage of admission, this Court has granted interim order on 12.07.2018, directing the respondents and their subordinates not to demolish or interfere with ::2::
peaceful possession of the petitioner over the house bearing No.3-35/3, admeasuring 30'x30' feet situated at Jalalpur Village, Varni Mandal, Nizamabad District without following due procedure contemplated under law.
4.
In spite of lapse of more than five (05) years, the respondents have not filed counter-affidavit or vacate petition denying the averments made by the petitioners in the writ affidavit.

5. In view of the same, the writ petition is disposed of, directing the respondents not to interfere with the possession of the petitioner's house bearing No.3-35/3, admeasuring 30'x30' feet situated at Jalalpur Village, Varni Mandal, Nizamabad District without following due procedure contemplated under law.

If the respondents want to acquire the property of the petitioner, they have to follow the procedure as contemplated under the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land ::3::
Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013.
